curatedMovie.curiosityHook: With both men operating on borrowed time inside hostile territory, which mole will crack the other's cover first?
curatedMovie.description: An undercover cop embedded deep within the mafia and a mob mole rising through the police force enter a desperate race to unmask each other before their dual lives unravel.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, heavy, and intensely suspenseful. A lean crime drama best experienced with complete, focused attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Its double-undercover premise gives this crime thriller a tense, focused setup built around two lives at risk of exposure.

facts.director: Alan Mak Siu-Fai & Andrew Lau Wai-Keung
facts.title: Infernal Affairs
